Pummel Permit is a crafting reagent used by engineers to craft the Crowd Pummeler 2-30. It is sold by Paxton Bombshell at Opportunity Point in the Ringing Deeps for a staggering cost of . A Pummel Permit can be obtained from using Pilfer Through Parts, but it is an exceedingly rare drop, with comments on WoWhead saying it took pilfering tens of thousands tier 3 gold reagents until players got 1 Pummel Permit. However, that might be worth it if you don't want to splurge 1 million gold on 1 crafting reagent.
